results.title: A 72-year-old Brighton supporter tragically passes away after falling unwell outside the Amex Stadium following the match against Aston Villa
results.description: Brighton and Hove Albion have announced the tragic death of a 72-year-old supporter who passed away after falling unwell shortly after Sunday's victory over Aston Villa. The fan was preparing to board a supporters' bus when the incident occurred, casting a devastating shadow over the opening weekend of the Premier League season at the Amex Stadium.
